label: Deliver at
hint: In the install's time zone (TZ in the deploy's env file).

label: Ignore articles older than (days)
hint: Counted from when an article was first seen. Also how far back Hacker News is searched, and how long a pick shown only as a link is tried again.

label: Model
hint: Does the routine work: ranking every candidate, reading the best in full, the extraction check and the notes. Most of the day's tokens, so a cheap model fits.

label: Tokens a day, at most
hint: Input (cached input too) and output together, all readers. A call that would cross it is skipped.

label: Articles read in full before choosing
hint: The best-ranked candidates are fetched and read by the model; 0 judges on titles and openings only.

label: Model for choosing the day's set
hint: One small call a day weighs the articles read in full together and picks a varied set; a stronger model here costs a few cents. Sonnet costs about 20 times Haiku.

label: Fallback model
hint: Used for the whole run when a model's connection cannot be reached as the run starts, such as a server at home that is switched off. Not when a model answers badly.

label: Check every article with an agent before it is sent
hint: The agent compares each article with the page it came from and fixes what extraction got wrong; each fix is listed on the Problems page. In a first run of 20 articles it fixed 6, for about 3 cents an article: roughly $0.30 a day per reader at ten articles. Its tokens count against its own budget below, not the ranking's.

label: Tokens a day for the check, at most
hint: All readers, cached input included, apart from the ranking's tokens a day. A check that fixes an article uses 100,000 to 200,000, mostly cached input at a tenth of the price: 3,000,000 is about $1 to $2 a day.

label: Model for the check
hint: An Anthropic model: the check looks at pictures of the page and edits the article with tools. With any other, the check is skipped and the run report says why.

label: Email when a run needs attention
hint: A failed delivery, a crashed run, or a source that keeps failing.

label: Failed runs in a row before a source is reported
Also when there was nothing new to deliver
Keep each article's saved page (days)
hint: -1 keeps them for good, 0 keeps none. They are the only copy of what was read.

label: Keep a copy of each book sent (days)
